comment: Savegame-visible id/flag pins. Append-only. Never renumber. retired_classes: ids withdrawn before any release; never reuse (the allocation cursor only counts up, so they cannot be). A retired entry keyed NAME_<id> is a class that still exists under NAME in another group but was moved off <id>; the suffix keeps the burned id unambiguous when the live name is still in use. A retired global flag keyed <name>_<bit> is a flag that moved off <bit> (the M1 shared-flag migration onto the retail bit); its old bits are dead forever, and validate() fails any live pin that overlaps them.
